title: Symbol Block
content:
How to Block a Symbol
Go to your Account Risk Settings
Scroll down to the Symbol Blocks section
Click the dropdown and select or search for the symbol you want to block (e.g., /ES for the S&P 500 E-mini)
Click “Add Block”
Click " Save" to save your settings
The symbol will now appear in the Current Symbol Blocks list

How to Block a Symbol

  1. Go to your Account Risk Settings

  2. Scroll down to the Symbol Blocks section

  3. Click the dropdown and select or search for the symbol you want to block (e.g., /ES for the S&P 500 E-mini)

  4. Click “Add Block”

  5. Click "Save" to save your settings

  6. The symbol will now appear in the Current Symbol Blocks list
